display_long_description:
**Join discord in [Discord.gg/soulforge]**

Mine, forge, fight, and fly with friends in Soul Forge, a FREE multiplayer VR social adventure. Gather ores, craft your own weapons, and take on monsters and powerful bosses together.

[media]

**🔥 Forge Your Weapon**

Collect more than 100 unique swords. Ranged and magic weapons are coming soon~

[media]

**⚔️ Fight With What You Made**

Defeat monsters and challenge powerful bosses with the weapons you forged.

[media]

**🪽 Fly Through the Air**

Soar through the skies with smooth movement and explore the world from above.

[media]
